string.text: Companion mod for ALifePlus by damian_sirbu. Requires ALifePlus to be enabled.

This mod provides several new conversation options. "Any interesting news?" will give you some gossip about locations on the current map. "What have you been up to?" will give you a rundown of ALifePlus goals and combat encounters which occurred during the NPC's day. "How are you holding up?" will give you details about their rank, health, and ALifePlus needs.
NPCs will also chatter. You'll hear nearby squad leaders announce ALifePlus goal changes, and you'll also hear stalkers in social areas spread gossip or talk about their ALifePlus needs.
Nearby stalkers at campfires and social areas will occasionally gossip about Zone events or their own day.
How often the campfire chatter scan fires. Lower values mean more frequent messages.
How close you need to be to an idling stalker for them to gossip.
The leaders of nearby stalker squads will chatter when their ALifePlus goal changes, as if you overheard them discuss their orders.
How close a squad member needs to be for their goal change chatter to reach you.
Faction only: Stalkers will only tell those on same faction

When ALifePlus records a high-signal event involving your faction or its allies (massacre, base attack, territory claim, stash loot, mutant sighting), a stationed member of the affected faction sends you a short PDA message: Breaking news from anywhere in the simulation, not just your current map.
Faction only: only events involving your own faction trigger a bark. Faction and allies: events involving any friendly faction also reach you.

ALifePlus lets a faction that holds a camp long enough grow real services there: a trader, barman, mechanic or medic you can actually use. They appear slowly and anywhere in the Zone, with nothing to tell you about it. With this on, the specialist sends you a PDA message when they set up, and stalkers will mention the outpost when you ask what's going on in the area.

Faction only: you are told about your own faction's outposts. Faction and allies: any friendly faction's outposts reach you too. Faction, allies and neutral: you also hear about outposts belonging to factions you are on neutral terms with. You can walk into their shop and trade, so it is worth knowing about. Hostile factions never tell you anything.

An outpost grows one service at a time. With this on, each new specialist announces their own arrival. With it off, only the outpost itself is announced and later arrivals stay quiet (you will still hear about them by asking a stalker about the area).

When enabled, the "Any interesting news?" dialog will also skip events tied to goals marked hidden or faction only. By default, area gossip treats all Zone events as public news (since these events have occurred in the past and thus word may have spread about them).
Creates a logfile for combat encounters and another logfile for all conversation output. Leave OFF for normal play.
